record.question: Francis, Kaplan and Propeller turbines fall under the category of -
record.explanation: Francis, Kaplan and propeller turbines are reaction turbines: the fluid pressure changes through the runner. Kaplan/propeller are axial-flow examples, but Francis need not be axial, so “reaction” is the shared class. Reference: https://archive.nptel.ac.in/content/storage2/courses/112104117/chapter_7/7_7.html; https://archive.nptel.ac.in/content/storage2/courses/112104117/chapter_7/7_10.html. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
